data.scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: No elevation/section supplied: z_floor=0, ceiling 3.0m, door height 2.1m, window sill 0.9m and head 2.4m are EXPLICIT ASSUMPTIONS, not observations.
Exterior wall thickness taken as the annotated 240mm; the drawn grey band is ~11px (~300mm) including finish; openings are placed on the outer-face plane.
Interior partitions drawn ~5px double lines; nominal 120mm assumed for thickness reporting only (BIM paths are midplanes).
Room roles inferred from furniture symbols (desks, meeting tables, conference oval, lounge counter), not from labels.
Door operating states unknown; swing directions read from leaf+arc symbols.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: All opening heights and the ceiling height are unverified against any drawing (no elevation supplied).
Outer left chain read as 4060+2940+4940+8080=20020 vs total 20000 (one label likely misread); inner chains used for calibration instead.
Measured east double door 614-669 (~1510mm) vs chain label 1600; measured pixel gap retained.
Corridor tail and east hall verified mutually open along x=459.5, y585-700 (no wall found); if the original intends a screen there it is unobserved.
Furniture, text and dimension annotations not modelled.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

plan_compilation.basis: Calibration from original dimension chains measured by pixel profiles: top chain ticks x=248/267/326/417/592/612 map to 0/540/2140/4660/9460/10000 mm (profile_001); left chain 20000 mm ticks y=151 and y=878 (profile_003/004), inner segments 540+1500+2380+1200+1740+1500+1220+1500+3080+4800+540=20000 match ticks within ~1px. Scale ~27.5 mm/px, orthogonal axes. Representative planes: footprint uses observed EXTERIOR outer faces (north grey band y150-161, south y866-877, west x248.5, east x612; wall annotated 240 on plan, drawn band ~11px incl. finish). Interior partitions are double-line thin walls (~5px, nominal 120mm); partition paths use measured MIDPLANES: top-room south wall y=298.5 (faces 296/301, profile_028); corridor west wall x=400 (faces 397/402.5, profiles_012/027); corridor east wall x=459.5 (faces 457/462, profile_026); cross wall HW2 y=403.5 (faces 399.5/407.5, profile_021); cross wall HW3 y=585 (faces 583/587, scale-5 crops on BOTH sides of the corridor: west 249-398, east 462-603, corridor gap 398-462 open); south-east wall y=700.5 (faces 697/704) and its return x=459.5. Openings measured as gaps in grey wall fill (profiles_005,008,009,015) plus cyan jamb ticks; chain labels agree within ~1-2px.
